answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the spiral of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, unlocked only after continuous uptime, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The ferrous holds work receipts rather than names, so the vertex of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
